acceptance_guard_for_future_hwao_authore: At represented 640x360 pixels, every scene-specific result/status gate and complete RESULT HELD capsule must remain fully above the bottom 25 percent obstruction boundary.
All seven exact scene-specific gate sentences must remain readable under both the 15 percent and 25 percent operational masks.

A generic RESULT HELD badge alone does not replace the scene-specific scope: locked inputs, archive-frame uncertainty, outcomes withheld, unavailable rungs, and separate-authorization conditions must remain direct readable text outside the obstructed zone.

No required qualifier, caveat, uncertainty, branch distinction, axis, unit, value, error bar, threshold, equation term, provenance fact, or interpretation limit may be carried only in the lower 25 percent of the represented frame.

Required scientific content should not be placed under a known obstruction merely to pass the guard; it must be duplicated or reflowed into an unobstructed readable hierarchy without deleting qualifiers.
All pixels above the declared obstruction boundary must remain unchanged by the mask transform; a mask receipt alone cannot certify this.
Global OCR is a diagnostic only. Mapped gate crops, complete-container review, and human review of represented pixels decide acceptance.
The 35 percent mask remains characterization only and is not an acceptance threshold.
